# Phone number parsing

libphonenumber-js 1.13.15, published npm package. MIT licence preserved alongside the bundle.

Source: https://github.com/catamphetamine/libphonenumber-js
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/libphonenumber-js/-/libphonenumber-js-1.13.15.tgz
SHA-512 (base64): AHdhEQeDFEJ4GKDAQ9AwxChy+v2kUILUB3TGQRpkXMkWePjXTU/WQEzWVQoIx/Gz8fE73Wr5SEuZCy2vk8jrMQ==

Only the min browser bundle and mobile examples are vendored. Source-map comment removed; examples exposed as an ES module. Country-aware parsing, formatting and possible-length validation run locally. No external phone lookup or verification occurs. Loaded on the intake and walkthrough only.
